notes: Technology context: '0p5W' SVT cells at 0.8 V nominal (0.72 V powerOK floor).
All numbers are TYPICAL intrinsic cell delays at a light fan-out; they are
plausible engineering placeholders, NOT characterized silicon data. The point
is to give the pure-digital model a realistic, SCALABLE amount of delay so the
ripple-counter / EOC timing margin can be probed (see examples/wur_ndiv/DELAYS.md).
Every value is multiplied by the global scale (JSON 'scale', CLI --scale, or the
xrun macro +define+VH_TPD_SCALE=<x>), so a 'slow corner' sweep needs no re-injection.
POLICY: the power-fail / reset branch (if(!powerOK) ... ) is NEVER delayed -- a
supply collapse or async clear must clamp immediately; delaying it would inject
phantom edges after power removal and would weaken the POWER-DOWN clean-0 check
for the wrong reason. Only the FUNCTIONAL branch of each model gets a delay.
The ext_stub/* entries stand in for red-zone COT std cells that the red zone
resolves through -v; they are listed here so the local margin sweep scales the
WHOLE design uniformly. On the red zone do NOT inject into the real COT models.

inv.rationale: SVT inverter, 0.8 V, moderate fan-out -- 10-15 ps band.

inv_pdiv.rationale: Prescaler/clock-tree inverter: up-sized, runs at 4.8-5.8 GHz, fastest inverter in the block.

nand2.rationale: 2-input NAND, series NMOS stack of 2 -- 15-25 ps band.

nor2.rationale: 2-input NOR, series PMOS stack of 2 (slower than NAND2 per stage).

nor4.rationale: 4-input NOR, 4-high PMOS stack -- the slowest static gate here (EOC detect).

mux.rationale: 2:1 inverting mux (TG pair + output inverter) -- 20-30 ps band.

mux_delay.rationale: The '..._delay' mux variant is the deliberately slower reload-path mux.

buf.rationale: Two-stage buffer (BUFFD2) = 2 x inverter + load -- 25-35 ps band.

dff.rationale: Static master-slave DFF clk->Q at 0.8 V -- 40-60 ps band. Async clear is NOT delayed (see POLICY).

tff.rationale: Toggle FF clk->q, same master-slave core as the DFF. Applied to BOTH the toggle and the ld (reload) branch, and to q and qb TOGETHER -- the original model had q@20ps / qb@10ps, an artificial q/qb skew that a real TFF does not have.

tspc_div2.rationale: TSPC divide-by-2, the FRONT-END /2 running at 4.8-5.8 GHz: dynamic, ratioed, only ~2-3 gate stages -> 25-35 ps clk->Q. Must stay well under Tvco/2 (86 ps @5.8 GHz).

power_sw.rationale: Header/footer power switch: big device, slow but NON-CRITICAL (enable path only) -- 50-100 ps band.

pdown.rationale: Power-down output clamp (pull-low / release-to-Z). Non-critical static path -- 50-100 ps band.

ext_inv.rationale: Stand-in for the red-zone COT INVD1/INVD8. Same as 'inv'; on red the real -v model rules.

ext_nand2.rationale: Stand-in for the red-zone COT ND2D1. Same as 'nand2'.

ext_nor2.rationale: Stand-in for the red-zone COT NR2D1. Same as 'nor2'.

delay_cell_a.rationale: DELAD1 is a DELAY CELL -- its delay IS its function; keep the stub's 40 ps (scales with the sweep).

delay_cell_b.rationale: DELBD1 delay cell -- keep the stub's 30 ps (scales with the sweep).
